How Do I?
Whether you're a resident, business owner, or visitor, this directory is designed to help you quickly find what you need—from county departments and elected officials to court services, public records, and community programs. Explore sections dedicated to Government, Services, Business Resources, and Community Support, or use the search and navigation tools to locate specific offices, contact information, and online services. At Trego County, we are committed to providing transparent, accessible, and efficient services to all who live, work, and spend time in our community.
Government
Departments & Services
County Boards & Minutes
Cities & Communities
Trego County, located in the heart of northwest Kansas, is dedicated to providing transparent, efficient, and responsive local government services to its residents. Through our Departments & Services , we aim to support the community’s needs with integrity and accountability. Stay informed on county decisions by exploring our County Board & Minutes , where you’ll find updates from the Board of County Commissioners. Learn more about the vibrant Cities & Communities that make up Trego County, each contributing to the rich heritage and welcoming spirit of our region.

Trego County is committed to making essential services accessible and easy to navigate for all residents. Whether you're looking for information on Court & Legal Services , handling Taxes & Finances , registering or renewing with Motor Vehicles , or learning about Recycling & Waste Management , we’re here to help. Our Health & Community Services also support the well-being and quality of life for everyone in the county. Explore each area to find the resources, contacts, and forms you need—all in one place.
Business Resources
Trego County Business Directory
Looking to support local or start something new in Trego? This Trego County Business Directory connects you to a wide range of businesses serving the community—from shops and restaurants to professional services and more. Click above to explore the full directory and discover what Trego County has to offer.

Accessibility Commitment for Trego County
At Trego County , we are committed to making our digital presence as accessible and inclusive as reasonably possible for all users, including individuals with disabilities. Our goal is to improve the usability of https://tregocountyks.gov and to support a more accessible experience for everyone, regardless of their abilities or the technologies they use.
Our Approach to Accessibility
We aim to align with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), which define internationally recognized standards for digital accessibility. While full compliance cannot always be guaranteed, we strive to implement improvements where feasible and regularly review accessibility-related aspects of our website. Accessibility is an ongoing process, and we are committed to improving the experience over time as technologies, standards, and user needs evolve.
Accessibility Features
To support accessibility, https://tregocountyks.gov may utilize tools such as the OneTap accessibility toolbar. This interface provides users with a range of helpful features, including:
Adjustable text size and contrast settings
Highlighting of links and text for better visibility
Full keyboard navigation of the toolbar interface
Quick launch via keyboard shortcut: Alt + . (Windows) or ⌘ + . (Mac)
Please note the following:
The availability and effectiveness of these features depend on the website's configuration and ongoing maintenance.
While we strive to ensure accessibility, we cannot guarantee that every part of https://tregocountyks.gov will be fully accessible at all times. Some content may be provided by third parties or affected by technical constraints beyond our immediate control.
Feedback and Contact
We welcome your feedback. If you experience any accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us: Email: info@tregocountyks.gov We are committed to reviewing all inquiries and aim to respond within 3–5 business days. If you require assistance accessing any part of this website, we are happy to provide support through alternative channels upon request. Last updated: March 12, 2026
